landing.title: ORCA
landing.titleSub: Marine EcOsystem Reasoning with Collaborative Agents
landing.heroDesc: An AI marine intelligence assistant that answers sea safety, fishing-zone, and weather-alert questions for Indian fishermen and coastal authorities — from live ocean and weather data, in plain conversation.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.heading: Coastal decisions run on fragmented information
problem.body1: Fishermen and coastal authorities along India's coastline make daily, safety-critical decisions — whether to go to sea, where to find fish, whether a cyclone is coming — using scattered sources: a weather app here, a radio bulletin there, word of mouth about where the last good catch was.
problem.body2: None of it is combined, none of it explains its reasoning, and by the time conflicting signals get reconciled, the window to act safely may have passed.

solution.label: The Solution
solution.heading: One question, one answer, a full evidence trail
solution.body: ORCA routes every question through a small team of specialized agents rather than a single opaque model call — so every answer can point to exactly which data and which rule produced it.

features.label: What It Does
features.heading: Built around what fishermen actually ask

safety.title: Sea Safety Verdicts
safety.desc: A live safe / caution / unsafe call for any coastal point, scored from wave height, wind speed, visibility, and active alerts — with the exact thresholds shown, not a black box.

pfz.title: Potential Fishing Zones
pfz.desc: Ranked PFZ recommendations from sea-surface temperature and chlorophyll concentration, the same signals used to identify productive fishing grounds.

alerts.title: Cyclone & Weather Alerts
alerts.desc: Active cyclone, lightning, and high-wave advisories sourced from IMD bulletins and cyclone tracking, surfaced the moment they matter.

coverage.title: Tamil Nadu's Full Coastline
coverage.desc: Every one of Tamil Nadu's 13 coastal districts resolves to a real fishing harbour or coastal town — from Pazhaverkadu to Kanyakumari — plus major coastal cities across India.

tech.label: Data & Reasoning
tech.heading: Real sources, honestly labelled
tech.body: Every response carries an evidence trail naming exactly which data source answered it — including when a live source is unavailable and a documented fallback was used instead, rather than silently guessing.

openMeteo.name: Open-Meteo
openMeteo.role: Live marine & weather data — wave height, wind, SST, visibility

imd.name: IMD
imd.role: India Meteorological Department — cyclone tracking & coastal bulletins

copernicus.name: Copernicus Marine Service
copernicus.role: Satellite chlorophyll-a for fishing-zone scoring, with seasonal climatology fallback when unavailable

llm.name: Groq
llm.role: LLM reasoning chain for natural-language, conversational answers

finalCta.heading: Ask ORCA before you head out.
